resources.string: Application font, import, editor font visibility and order

Use an imported font throughout the app interface, including chats, messages and settings. Only imported fonts can be selected. Apply by restarting the app. Code, decorative fonts, web pages and system screens keep their own fonts. Android may synthesize bold and italic styles.
Show the system font families supported by the media editor

Visible fonts are available in the media editor text tool. Drag the handle to reorder them; tap the eye to hide or show a font. Tap an imported font to delete it. Hiding a font does not change saved media text or the application font. If all fonts are hidden, the editor keeps its default font available.
Delete this imported font? If selected as the application font, the default will be restored after restart. Media text using this font may fall back to another font.
Choose a TTF, OTF or TTC file up to 20 MiB. Up to 32 imported fonts are supported. Files are copied into the app’s private storage.
Could not load or save the font. Choose a valid TTF, OTF or TTC file up to 20 MiB, check free storage, and make sure the library has fewer than 32 imported fonts.
